summary: Verified new AzoApp real-time chat features end-to-end: chats summary endpoint, seen receipts (sent/seen + seen_at), typing indicator, SSE frames (booking_typing / booking_message with service_name+code+status / booking_seen), chat notification payload shape, and push suppression while recipient is present. Backend: 8/8 new pytest tests pass. Web UI (dual browser contexts partner+customer): all data-testids present and behave correctly including deep-link auto-open with param removal, typing bubble, tick-sent → tick-seen live transition, unread pill add/remove. Mobile web build via Expo tunnel: onboarding, demo-partner login, /active card chat button + unseen badge, navigation to full-screen /chat/<id>, typing indicator, and auto-seen propagation to web customer all work.
critical_code_review_comments: Notification push suppression window (25s) is time-based; if a partner marks seen then closes the sheet within 25s, subsequent unseen messages will NOT create notification records — this is intentional but worth documenting for QA.
chat_controller / BookingChat.jsx: 700+ line files bordering the code-review size threshold; consider splitting seen/typing/message list logic into hooks for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded booking 78f7a5f4-9784-4680-a7fe-17d5f94e9496 (AZO4A0D87). Test messages prefixed with TEST_ were sent into that thread.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new chat features (seen ticks, typing, chats summary, SSE realtime frames, notification payload, push suppression, deep link, mobile chat screen) are verified passing on iteration_79. Backend regression test file is /app/backend/tests/test_chat_seen_typing_summary.py (run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported). SSE tests are timing-sensitive; if they flake in future re-runs, increase the collect deadline in TestSSEFrames.
